name: look
description: See the box now: your position, health and the pile under you, the nearest enemies (offsets from you, kind, health, whether winding up a strike), the pile's height across the floor, the rim, the clock and which doors are opening. Takes no game time.

name: status
description: A short summary: box, health, time left, kills, escapes, game seconds played, and whether the run is over. Takes no game time.

name: move
description: Run in a compass direction for some seconds (6 m/s). North is away from the camera toward the back wall, east is right. You face the way you move, and step up debris ledges up to 0.4 m on your own (there is no jump).

name: punch
description: Punch: a quick, short blow into a cone in front of you that snaps onto the nearest enemy in it. With a direction you first turn that way (a short step). While holding something, a punch spin-throws it instead, toward the biggest group in front of you. Takes about half a second.

name: kick
description: Kick: slower and harder than a punch, longer reach, and it staggers thugs (punches don't). Straight after a dash it is a drop-kick, the hardest blow. With a direction you first turn that way. While holding something, it spin-throws it instead. Takes about half a second.

name: dash
description: Dash a few metres in a direction, fast (0.5 s cooldown). Advances only the dash's first instant, so a kick or punch called next lands during it as a drop-kick.

name: grab
description: Grab the nearest enemy or debris piece just in front of you (frozen debris comes loose), holding it in front of you; grab again to set it down in front. Punch or kick while holding to spin-throw it: thrown things hurt every enemy they pass through.
